section.content: 本发明提供一种半导体集成电路，通过以CMOS工序构成的电路单元(1)至(3)与连接于此的模拟控制线(5#-[-1]、5#-[-2]、5#-[-3])在布局上不重叠的方式，以模拟控制线(5#-[-1]、5#-[-2])迂回在AM・FM共同电路单元(3)的布局外部的方式进行配线，由此，尽量使AM・FM电路单元(3)内的信号线与模拟控制线(5#-[-1]、5#-[-2])的距离分开，以便使AM・FM电路单元(3)内的信号线与模拟控制线(5#-[-1]、5#-[-2])不借助寄生电容而结合，从而可抑制在信号线与模拟控制线(5#-[-1]、5#-[-2])之间引起信号相互干涉。

In order for circuit blocks 1 to 3 composed by the CMOS process, and analog lines 5 <SUB>-1</SUB> , 5 <SUB>-2</SUB>, and 5 <SUB>-3 </SUB>connected thereto not to overlap on the layout, the analog lines 5 <SUB>-1 </SUB>and 5 <SUB>-2 </SUB>are wired so that such lines roundabout the layout of the AM/FM common circuit block 3 . Through this, the distance of the signal line within the AM/FM common circuit block 3 and the analog lines 5 <SUB>-1 </SUB>and 5 <SUB>-2 </SUB>can become as long as possible, the signal line within the AM/FM common circuit block 3 and the analog lines 5 <SUB>-1 </SUB>and 5 <SUB>-2 </SUB>would not be coupled via parasitic capacity, and mutual interference occurring between the signal line and the analog lines 5 <SUB>-1 </SUB>and 5 <SUB>-2 </SUB>can be suppressed.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, be particularly useful on a chip integrated a plurality of circuit units and on each circuit unit, connect the semiconductor integrated circuit of the CMOS structure of simulation control line.

Background technology

In order to the technology of making semiconductor device is GaAs (arsenic germanium) technology with Si (silicon) bipolarity technology, compound semiconductor, CMOS technology etc.Wherein, little low-voltage also can be worked, can carry out features such as high speed operation, low cost of manufacture under the state of miniaturization even if the CMOS technology has the electric power of consumption, is used for semiconductor device now more.

Wherein, receive high-frequency signal and RF (Radio Frequency) circuit (analog circuit portion) bipolarity technology or the GaAs technology used handled more, do not use the CMOS technology so far as yet.This is because the CMOS technology mainly is applicable to the technology of digital circuit, can't fully obtain the cause of the high frequency characteristics of good S/N in cmos circuit.

Yet, in recent years, in the semiconductor chips such as WLAN that bluetooth (bluetooth) or use 5GHz towards the near radio data communication technology are with, introduce the CMOS technology gradually.This be because be that prepreerence portable phone is different with the sound conversation because bluetooth or WLAN are based on data communication, therefore compare slowly with portable phone in the fiducial value of the required characteristic of RF circuit.Yet, if the improvement of CMOS technology from now on is showing improvement or progress day by day, infer that portable phone etc. also can introduce the CMOS technology,

In addition, highly integrated, the multifunction of semiconductor in recent years, and also be provided at a plurality of IC of integrated a plurality of circuit units on the semiconductor chip.So, in that a plurality of circuit units are integrated during at a slice chip, to consume electric power etc. be purpose to reduce, expectation can be on each circuit unit the conducting/disconnection of independent control power supply.

For example, AM broadcast receiver broadcasting is integrated in the circuit of a chip with two side's receiving functions of FM broadcast receiver broadcasting, when receiving the broadcasting of AM broadcast receiver, the circuit unit of must conducting AM using, the circuit unit that disconnection FM uses; When receiving the broadcasting of FM broadcast receiver, must disconnect the circuit unit that AM uses, the circuit unit that conducting FM uses.Therefore, not only need conducting/disconnection to accumulate in the power supply of the outside of chip, on each circuit unit of chip internal, must possess the structure of the conducting/disconnection of control power supply.

If use the integrated circuit of bipolar transistor in the past, even then because little transistor also can be realized big driving force, thus the transistor that switch is used is set on each circuit unit, by controlling the conducting/disconnection of this transistor switchable power supply.

Yet, on the transistorized integrated circuit of CMOS,, therefore on the foundation of each circuit unit, can't adopt the transistorized structure of so-called switch only is set because wherein the driving force of employed MOSFET (field-effect transistor) is not high.Therefore, under the situation of CMOS technology, must carry out indivedual controls of power turn-on/disconnection to each transistor that in circuit unit, uses.Certainly, the number of transistors that is used for power supply control will become many.

In addition, when the conducting of individual other transistor being carried out power supply/disconnection control, when conducting, transistorized grid becomes the quick condition that can't get in touch with arbitrary place.Under this state, transistor will become high impedance and be easy to generate the state of noise.According to circumstances different, must be provided with in order to interdict the switching transistor of the error job that produces because of this noise in addition, will cause transistorized quantity to increase.

So, in IC chip, on each circuit unit, need the transistor of a plurality of conducting/disconnections in order to the control power supply in order to the CMOS of integrated a plurality of circuit units.Therefore, for above-mentioned transistor, roll up in order to the bar number of the simulation control line of supplying with control signal.Certainly, when constituting analog circuit, also become many in order to the quantity of the simulation control line of control circuit work with the CMOS technology.As a result, make the distribution area in the IC chip increase.

In CMOS operation in the past, maximize for fear of the chip size that causes because the distribution area of control line increases, so use multilayer wired, on the upper strata or lower floor of circuit unit, on layout with the mode distribution control line of superposing circuit unit.Fig. 1 is the distribution layout example that shows this moment.

IC chip 100 shown in Figure 1 is to possess to have with lower member: carry out the peculiar processing of AM circuit unit 1, carry out the circuit unit 2 of the peculiar processing of FM, circuit unit 3 and the control circuit 4 that carries out the common processing of AM and FM.Distribution has simulation control line 105 between each circuit unit 1 to 3 and the control circuit 4 -1To 105 -3

In the example of Fig. 1, from the be pulled simulation control line 105 of AM circuit unit 1 of control circuit 4 -1, from the be pulled simulation control line 105 of FM circuit unit 2 of control circuit 4 -2Be for the chip size that prevents the distribution area becomes big, so overlapping distribution is on (correct is distribution on the wiring layer different with AM, FM common circuit unit 3) AM, FM common circuit unit 3.

Yet so, when superposing circuit unit and distribution simulation control line, equivalence forms parasitic capacitance to the holding wire in the circuit unit by insulating barrier with the simulation control line, the result, will cause in the circuit unit holding wire with simulate control line electric capacity and combine.

Therefore, cause between holding wire and simulation control line and pass on signal mutually, cause mutual interference by parasitic capacitance.Its result, the quality that exists in the analog signal that flows on the holding wire is based on the problem of deterioration from simulating the overlapping control signal of control line.In addition, the control signal that flows on the simulation control line also has what is called to cause the problem of error job because change from the overlapped signal of holding wire.

Particularly, use recently often a kind of conduct to be integrated in a plurality of circuit units on a slice chip and so-called analog digital with analog circuit unit and digital circuit unit is mixed a year LSI.Carry among the LSI this mixing, on the upper strata of digital circuit unit or lower floor's distribution when the simulation control line is arranged, digital signal by the parasitic capacitance voltage that square etc. is big overlaps in the small analog control signal fully, so that the problem that causes error job is easily arranged.

Summary of the invention

The present invention finishes in order to address the above problem, purpose is when using the CMOS technology to be integrated in a plurality of circuit units on a slice chip, prevent by being connected in each circuit unit the simulation control line in conjunction with noise, with the deterioration that suppresses analog feature or the error job of circuit.

Semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention possesses the circuit unit that constitutes with the CMOS operation; And the simulation control line that is connected in the foregoing circuit unit, it is characterized in that foregoing circuit unit and above-mentioned simulation control line are disposed at above-mentioned simulation control line the layout outside of foregoing circuit unit not overlap the mode of identical or different wiring layer.

Alternate manner of the present invention is characterized in that, possessing has with lower member: a plurality of circuit units with CMOS operation formation with conducting/break function of power supply; And be connected the simulation control line in order to conducting/disconnection of controlling above-mentioned power supply of above-mentioned a plurality of circuit units; Above-mentioned a plurality of circuit unit and above-mentioned simulation control line are disposed at above-mentioned simulation control line the layout outside of above-mentioned a plurality of circuit units not overlap the mode of identical or different wiring layer.

Another way of the present invention is characterized in that, possesses with lower member on same chip: a plurality of circuit units with CMOS operation formation with conducting/break function of power supply; Control circuit in order to power turn-on/disconnection of controlling above-mentioned a plurality of circuit units; And be connected simulation control line between above-mentioned a plurality of circuit unit and the above-mentioned control circuit, wherein at the above-mentioned simulation control line of the layout exterior arrangement of above-mentioned a plurality of circuit units, or on the layout of certain circuit unit, when configuration is controlled to be conducting based on above-mentioned control circuit with the power supply of above-mentioned certain circuit unit, meanwhile for the simulation control line of other circuit unit that is not controlled to be conducting.

The another mode of the present invention is the semiconductor integrated circuit that possesses the CMOS structure of the analog circuit with feedback loop, it is characterized in that, the analog signal line of above-mentioned feedback loop is configured in the outside of above-mentioned analog circuit layout.

Because the present invention constitutes with above-mentioned technological means, near holding wire in the circuit unit and simulation control line must not be configured in mutually, do not produce parasitic capacitance so that make the holding wire in this circuit unit and simulate between the control line, can prevent combination by parasitic capacitance.

In addition, according to another feature of the present invention,, can dwindle the area of integrated circuit by the simulation control line of overlapping other circuit unit of distribution on the layout of certain circuit unit.In addition, even near the simulation control line of holding wire in certain circuit unit and other circuit unit is configured in mutually, because therefore flow signals simultaneously not on this holding wire and simulation control line can suppress this holding wire and interfere mutually with the signal of simulating between the control line.
